page.title: to不定詞は行為を指し示す

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、to＋動詞原形が一つの行為を名詞のようなまとまりとして指し示し、主語・目的語・補語などの名詞の席に入る仕組みを示している。特に文頭主語のto不定詞は、個別の体験よりも行為一般・規則・原則を宣言する響きが出やすく、実際の場面を生き生き捉える-ing主語との視点差が重要である。
grammarPoints: to＋動詞原形で行為を一まとまりにし、文の主語として使えること
plan・decide・hope・agree・expectなどの後ろでto不定詞を目的語として使うこと
be動詞の後ろで目的・目標・方針の内容をto不定詞で示せること
文頭のto不定詞は行為一般、規則、原則、仮定的判断を目立たせやすいこと
長いto不定詞主語は形式主語itを使って後ろへ送ることもできること
to不定詞主語と-ing主語は多くの場合置換可能でも、一般論と具体的な体験の焦点が異なること
visualEvidence: 中央の「TO→base verb」という金色の矢印が、toの後ろに動詞原形を置いて行為を指す仕組みを示している
to不定詞のまとまりが文組み立て機の名詞スロットへ入る図が、句全体を主語や目的語として扱うことを表している
周囲の「主語・目的語・後ろから説明・itを補う」という四つの行き先が、to不定詞の主要な配置を地図のように整理している
TOレンズと-INGレンズの対比が、行為一般・規則と実際の場面・体験の見え方の違いを示している
文頭の長いto不定詞へ当たるスポットライトが、宣言や原則として強く目立つ語感を示している
commonTraps: toの後ろに動詞原形ではなく-ing形や過去形を置く
to不定詞句を主語にしたのに、述語動詞を複数扱いする
decide・plan・hopeなどto不定詞を取る動詞の後ろに-ing形を置く
一般的な規則を述べる場面と、一度の具体的体験を描写する場面の焦点差を無視する
長いto不定詞主語と形式主語itの対応を崩し、itとto不定詞のどちらかを欠く
to不定詞の目的・目標内容と、前置詞to＋名詞・動名詞を混同する

questions.prompt: ------- a visitor badge inside the data center is mandatory.

choices.A: Wearing yesterday
choices.B: Wears
choices.D: To wearing

questions.translationJa: データセンター内で来訪者用バッジを着用することは必須です。

questions.prompt: ------- the application online saves applicants several minutes.

choices.B: Submitted

questions.prompt: Our main goal this quarter is ------- energy use by ten percent.

choices.B: reduced

questions.prompt: ------- cleaning chemicals beside food supplies is not permitted.

choices.B: Stored

questions.focus: 規則を表すto不定詞主語

questions.prompt: The interns hope ------- the client presentation next Thursday.

choices.D: to joining

questions.prompt: ------- without current cost data would make the contract negotiations unnecessarily risky.

choices.A: Negotiated
choices.B: To negotiating
choices.D: Negotiates

questions.prompt: The committee's intention is ------- paper invoices over the next two years.

choices.B: phased out

choices.B: To enter the laboratory without authorization is prohibited.

choices.D: To enter the laboratory without authorization are prohibited.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about keeping expense records.

choices.B: To keeping receipts makes reimbursement easier.
choices.D: To keep receipts makes reimbursement easier.

choices.D: Ms. Ito plan to visits the Osaka branch in October.

choices.D: Compare three bids takes careful analysis.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the technicians' agreement.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing an unrealistic service standard.

choices.A: To answer every call within twenty seconds are unrealistic.
choices.B: To answer every call within twenty seconds is unrealistic.
choices.C: To answering every call within twenty seconds is unrealistic.
choices.D: Answered every call within twenty seconds is unrealistic.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a team objective.

choices.A: Our objective to shorten delivery times is.
choices.B: Our objective is shortening delivery times tomorrow.
choices.C: Our objective is to shorten delivery times.
choices.D: Our objective is to shortened delivery times.

questions.translationJa: 私たちの目標は配送時間を短縮することです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence evaluating a major system change.

choices.B: To replacing the entire system now would create more disruption than it would prevent.
choices.C: Replace the entire system now would creates more disruption than it would prevent.
choices.D: To replace the entire system now will creating more disruption than it prevents.

questions.translationJa: 今システム全体を交換することは、防げる以上の混乱を生むでしょう。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a formal compliance principle.

choices.B: To disclosed client data without consent violates company policy.
choices.C: To disclosing client data without consent violates company policy.
choices.D: To disclose client data without consent violates company policy.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using a long to-infinitive naturally.

choices.A: The directors consider prudent to delay the vote it.
choices.B: The directors consider it prudent to delay the vote.
choices.C: The directors consider it to prudent delaying the vote.
choices.D: The directors considers it prudent delay the vote.

questions.translationJa: 取締役たちは採決を延期するのが賢明だと考えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “To use the premium service requires registration.”

choices.A: The premium service registers every user automatically.
choices.B: Registration was completed after one use.
choices.C: Users are required registering the premium service.
choices.D: Anyone wishing to use the premium service must register.

questions.translationJa: プレミアムサービスを利用したい人は登録しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 元文は「サービス利用には登録が必要」という一般条件です。Dが同じ条件関係を自然に言い換えています。
questions.focus: to不定詞主語の条件言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The team hopes to finish the report today.”

choices.A: The team finished the report earlier than expected.
choices.B: The team hopes that it will complete the report today.
choices.C: The report hopes to be finished by the team.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “To park in front of the loading bay is forbidden.”

choices.A: The loading bay has no parking spaces left.
choices.B: Drivers parked in front of the loading bay yesterday.
choices.C: Parking is not allowed in front of the loading bay.
choices.D: Vehicles may wait in front of the loading bay at any time.

choices.C: Only trained presses can operate workers safely.
choices.D: Operating the press removes the need for training.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “It is essential to back up the customer database.”

choices.A: To back up the customer database is essential.

choices.C: The database backs up customers who are essential.
choices.D: Backing up the database is optional.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The purpose of the survey is to identify service gaps.”

choices.A: The survey was identified as a service gap.
choices.B: Service gaps prevented the survey from having a purpose.
choices.C: The survey is intended to find areas where service is insufficient.
choices.D: The survey identifies why no purpose exists.

choices.B: It would be risky to approve the plan before it receives a legal review.
choices.C: The plan was risky because it had already been legally approved.

questions.translationJa: 法務審査を受ける前にその計画を承認するのは危険でしょう。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The client expects to receive the revised estimate by noon.”
